claims.title: P2 heritable photonic matter: synthetic selection and unearned physical expression

quoted_fields.interface: Common-bath allele-addressed PDI/6HB optical material is proposed. The source reports executed motif-candidate and synthetic fresh-preparation FRET selection models;physical PDI decoding,clonal expression and recovered functional heredity are not demonstrated.
quoted_fields.failure: Unmeasured correlated occupancy/global-fold and genotype-by-batch variability can prevent reproducibility. Corrected models count all input genomes;active-acceptor normalization did not measure manufactured yield. Ten ideal decoupled binary dimer cells give at most11spectra,not1024functions. No experimental evolution,practical advantage or historical breakthrough. N1673 is a distinct peptide-handoff predecessor.
